requirements.description: Authenticated access with 4 demo accounts, role-based capabilities, and server-side authentication boundaries
Navigation across Constellation, Command queue, Telemetry, and (admin-only) Administration workspaces
Constellation status board showing all four craft, open anomalies, and a reachable command queue
Analyst visibility scoped to assigned craft only, on both list and search, enforced server-side rather than UI-hidden
Command execution gated on the craft's own contact window, checked at execution time (not only at queueing), half-open boundary inclusive, forged window/craft claims ignored
Burn propellant checked against what is actually left in the tank (not its rated size), exact-fit boundary accepted, forged remaining-propellant claims ignored
Battery draw checked against the craft's actual charge and its own reserve floor, exact-on-reserve boundary accepted, forged charge/draw claims ignored
A craft with a failed checkout accepts no new work; cancelling the blocking command does not clear it; only a fresh passed checkout does
Executed and cancelled commands are terminal and refuse all further action; duplicate command references are refused on create

High-energy burns (above the 50 m/s line) require a flight director's authorization from someone other than the submitter; at-or-below the line is the submitter's own call; a director's standing is re-checked at the moment they act, so a demotion bites on the very next write
Append-only audit trail covering authorizations, uplinks, cancellations and role changes, with no route to add, edit, or remove an entry
SQLite durable persistence of command and craft state across page reload and re-authentication
Theme switching, mobile-responsive layout with scrollable navigation, accessible semantic markup, and interactive feedback
